positionReference.basis: The museum group photograph identifies the central low log White Kitchen, green hip, pale chimney, left wooden door and two divided white windows. Ordinary aerial imagery shows the matching separate green roof in the service courtyard behind Tolstoy House, with the southwest flower bed matching the ground photo. The retained PMTiles and current OSM neighborhood map omit this footprint; reject toilet way167382259 as unrelated. Photo-derived roof center[37.526028,54.076367] and9.6x7m plan are author estimates, about5m positional/15degree facing uncertainty, not an OSM or surveyed footprint. X southeast follows the visible roof; front+Z southwest faces the flower bed. Existing mapped buildings stay independent.

members.title: Icehouse

positionReference.basis: Two ordinary courtyard photos show the same independent low log outbuilding with steep weathered board gable roof, horizontal timber gable, small triangular vent and braced low door immediately beside the kitchen. The aerial roof northeast of the kitchen supplies approximate center[37.526115,54.076448] and southwest-facing gable axis. Assignment as the icehouse rather than woodshed remains an explicit estate-context inference: the photographs are grouped under kitchen and do not label this outbuilding individually. This is an original specific exterior interpretation, not a generic icehouse preset. Standard PMTiles/current OSM omit its footprint; own or replace no native building. Position about5m/facing20degrees are author estimates, not measured bounds.

membershipEvidence.note: Four members have current placements and seven have dated historical placements. The King David Hotel miniature uses the planting-island fit for the panorama published on 17 May 2012. The airport apron uses the panorama published on 17 May 2012 and a bounded grade for that date. The power station and Yad Eliyahu Arena use dated November 2011 panoramas. The Dizengoff Center towers use the archive published on 17 May 2012.

members.title: Mini Israel · Ben Gurion Airport exhibit

positionReference.basis: The 2012 panorama fixes the west-southwest camera and the signed aircraft poses. The reconstruction is scaled uniformly to 89% around that camera and clears the nearest mapped visitor path by 2.7706 m. A date-specific ground grade seats the deck at all tested detail levels. The historical grade and the original platform dimensions are estimates.

members.title: Mini Israel · Yad Eliyahu Arena exhibit

positionReference.basis: Four November 2011 panorama stations place the model on the paved platform below the wooden terrace. The cutaway faces approximately 340 degrees true. The model and platform grade load during the documented month. The current display condition remains unverified.

members.title: Mini Israel · Orot Rabin Power Station exhibit

positionReference.basis: The four November 2011 panoramas place the miniature beside the visitor plaza at an apron bearing of 262.1° true. The fitted apron clears the nearest PMTiles path by 1.21 m. Its retaining edge reaches the rendered canal surface. In the dated view the water mask follows the two dry apron outlines, with the rest of the canal and the path preserved. The exact capture day, original platform elevation and present exhibit condition remain unresolved.

positionReference.basis: Three archived views locate the two towers by their distinct silhouettes. Their centers fix an approximate signed axis. The May 2012 reconstruction sits in the Tel Aviv exhibit bed beside the entrance frontage.
